summary: The implementation provides a solid foundation for the student tracking system with backend data models and frontend interfaces for students, marks, and attendance. However, several critical backend methods are missing (getAllStudents, updateStudent, deleteStudent), preventing full CRUD functionality. The visual theme requirement is mostly met with Tailwind CSS styling, though some acceptance criteria lack complete evidence.

missing_requirements.requirement: Students can be retrieved by ID or roll number
missing_requirements.reason: Backend only implements getStudent(id: Nat) for retrieval by ID. No method exists to retrieve students by roll number as specified in the acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: Marks can be queried by student, subject, or date range
missing_requirements.reason: Backend only implements getMarksByStudent(). No methods exist to query marks by subject or date range as specified in the acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: Attendance can be queried by student or date range
missing_requirements.reason: Backend only implements getAttendanceByStudent(). No method exists to query attendance by date range as specified in the acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: Attendance can be marked as present, absent, or late for each date
missing_requirements.reason: Backend attendance model uses a boolean 'present' field, which only supports present/absent states. The 'late' status is not supported as specified in the acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ability to edit existing student information
missing_requirements.reason: No updateStudent() backend method exists. Frontend shows alert acknowledging this missing functionality.
No deleteStudent() backend method exists. Frontend shows alert acknowledging this missing functionality.
No getAllStudents() backend method exists. Frontend displays placeholder message instead of student list.

missing_requirements.requirement: Search or filter functionality to find specific students
missing_requirements.reason: Search UI exists but cannot function without getAllStudents() method to retrieve and filter student records.

missing_requirements.requirement: Interface to mark attendance for all students on a given date
missing_requirements.reason: Bulk attendance marking interface cannot be implemented without getAllStudents() method. Frontend shows alert acknowledging this limitation.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile management system with roles (Teacher, Administrator, Staff)
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest has no requirements for user profiles, role management, or multi-user authentication. The system implements UserProfile type, profile setup modal, and role-based functionality not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Authorization and access control system with admin/user permissions
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest specifies single-actor architecture but does not request authorization, access control, or permission systems. Backend implements MixinAuthorization and AccessControl modules.
BuildRequest does not specify any authentication requirements or Internet Identity integration. Implementation includes full II auth flow with login/logout.
BuildRequest does not request dark mode or theme switching functionality. CSS and components implement full dark mode color schemes.

hallucinated_features.description: Mobile responsive menu with hamburger navigation
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not specify mobile responsiveness requirements. Layout implements mobile menu toggle functionality.
